recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future DICOM terminology freshness should continue under the DICOM-published package/value-set policy from FHIR-22483 and FHIR-24908; cleanup of inactive Media or removed ImagingManifest files should be handled separately as retired-source cleanup, not as a FHIR-12947 source fix.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking that DICOM-derived value sets such as instance-availability, DICOM CID-29, AuditEvent type/subtype, DICOM CID-405 media type, and KOS title consistently identify whether DICOM or FHIR defines them.
initial_application: No historical source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-12947 was found. The issue appears to have been applied through later DICOM terminology work: fcf583e852 removed the local ImagingStudy DICOM CID-29 value set, and 26f1439636 / PR #951 switched AuditEvent and ImagingStudy terminology to DICOM-authored value sets while deleting local DICOM-derived copies such as valueset-dicm-405-mediatype.
additional_context: FHIR-24908 and FHIR-22483 later formalized using DICOM-published FHIR CodeSystems and ValueSets. The combined branch already contains the FHIR-22483 correction for the active Composition CID-29 import. source/fhir.ini keeps relevant active resources but not Media, lists ImagingManifest as removed, and has no active [valuesets] entries for the old local DICOM copies; the remaining hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/dicom-cid29 hit is in inactive Media source, while KOS title remains under removed ImagingManifest and OID history.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because active DICOM value set references already point to DICOM CID canonicals, and the remaining local artifacts named in the original issue are either intentionally mixed FHIR example value sets importing DICOM plus local additions or legacy/out-of-build source.
